This half duplex on Columbine Lane offers a comfortable retreat within easy reach of downtown Denver, combining urban convenience with a quiet suburban setting. Inside, an open floor plan showcases quartz countertops, soft-close cabinetry, a suite of stainless appliances, and smart home technology, along with 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths (including an ensuite primary bath), and an oversized 2-car garage.

This home at Mississippi offers a sleek, modern concept with clean lines inside and out, thoughtfully oriented for natural light. The split-level floor plan features a Scandinavian-inspired, open-concept upper level with a welcoming living room, kitchen, dining area, and half bath, while all four bedrooms are nestled in a private lower level with three full bathrooms. A welcoming back yard and detached single-car garage complete the home, just minutes from Cherry Creek's shopping, dining, and entertainment.

This desirable end-unit LiteTowns residence in Denver's City Park West neighborhood offers 2 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, and 1,616 square feet of low-maintenance living. Extra windows on the end unit bring in enhanced privacy and abundant natural light, while the gourmet kitchen features quartz countertops, soft-close cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances. An attached 1-car garage adds secure parking, just minutes from City Park, Cheesman Park, and Downtown Denver. Governed by a Party Wall Agreement; monthly fee is $113.

This exceptional custom home in Denver's prestigious Observatory Park neighborhood sits on a rare 11,693 sq ft street-to-street double lot with no alley, offering 6 bedrooms, 6 full baths, and 2 powder baths across roughly 8,101 square feet. Built by Dublin Development, the home features a private elevator, main-level guest suite, and a flexible floor plan suited to multigenerational living. The chef's kitchen includes Wolf appliances, quartz countertops, Bellmont cabinetry, a steam oven, and a separate butler's pantry, while White Oak hardwood floors and designer finishes carry through every room. The finished lower level offers a wet bar, rec room, home theater, and fitness studio, and a rooftop lounge and private deck upstairs are made for taking in Colorado sunsets. An oversized 3-car garage with car-lift compatibility, Marvin triple-pane windows, and accordion doors for indoor-outdoor living round out the home, just minutes from Cherry Creek and the University of Denver.

This modern new construction townhome in Rosedale offers a rare three-primary-suite layout across 3 bedrooms and 3.5 baths. The third floor is dedicated to an additional primary suite with a large bath, walk-in closet, and private rooftop deck access, while the second floor holds two more primary bedrooms, each with a walk-in closet and en-suite bath. Finishes include a stainless steel appliance package, quartz countertops and backsplash, soft-close shaker cabinetry, LVP flooring, and a private yard, plus a one-car detached garage. Walkable to Platt Park and Harvard Gulch with a Walk Score of 88 and no HOA.

Luxury Meets Sustainability in this Stunning 2-Story Home by redT Homes. Welcome to this exceptional two-story residence where modern luxury and eco-conscious design come together. This spacious layout features 3 bedrooms upstairs and a dedicated main-floor study, offering the ideal balance of comfort, work, and relaxation. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream with stainless steel appliances, shaker-style cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a convenient butler's pantry for extra prep and storage space. Designer lighting, rich hardwood flooring, and elegant matte black and champagne bronze hardware bring a touch of sophistication throughout. The open-concept living area is filled with natural light, thanks to an oversized sliding glass door that opens to the beautifully landscaped backyard-perfect for indoor-outdoor living. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite includes two walk-in closets and a spa-inspired bathroom with freestanding soaking tub, dual vanities, and an oversized tiled shower. The finished basement expands your living space with a media/theatre room, large recreation area, two additional bedrooms, and a sleek wet bar featuring countertop seating, a mini fridge, and dishwasher-ideal for entertaining or casual living. A rare 4-car garage adds functionality, and the home is just steps from the Unified Trail leading to the new recreation center. Located minutes from the TPC golf course and downtown Berthoud, this is a must-see home that blends thoughtful design, upscale finishes, and unmatched energy efficiency. Don't miss your chance to call this exceptional property home!

This beautifully remodeled 2-story townhome in the mountain town of Leadville features an eat-in kitchen with quartz countertops, new appliances, and bar-top seating, plus two covered decks with mountain views and a fenced rear patio. Includes 3 off-street parking spaces, an under-stair storage closet, and a walk-in closet. Walking distance to downtown Leadville's shops and restaurants and adjacent to the Mineral Belt recreational trail, with Ski Cooper just 10 minutes away. HOA covers electric, gas, heat, water, sewer, snow removal, trash, grounds maintenance, insurance, and management.

Prime redevelopment opportunity in Englewood. Existing house currently on the property, with the seller in the process of completing key pre-development work, offering significant time and cost savings for the next owner. Buyer may benefit from progress already underway on survey, soils, asbestos abatement, demolition, engineering, and architectural planning. Seller is willing to close upon issuance of permits, providing a streamlined path to construction. Building plans are in Supplements. This project can be delivered fully entitled. The 6,403 square foot lot is zoned for a single-family residence and is ideally located near local amenities, schools, and transportation.

Property and price offer options. Scrape and rebuild like the duplex to the west or renovate to rent or fix and flip! House has been taken care of and is clean and in rent condition inside, the exterior needs a little love. 6,250-square-foot lot in zoned for up to 2 units. Owner occupants easy sweat equity here and an opportunity to renovate to your style and standards. Conveniently located with easy access to downtown Denver, Sloan's Lake 7 blocks to the north and amazing restaurants, bars, coffee, yoga, and more a short 7 block walk or bike away to get to all that the south side of Sloan's Lake offers! A great opportunity to own a single-family home and land in an established Denver neighborhood under 350K! This property is sold "As-Is".

Tastefully remodeled and thoughtfully updated, this mid-century modern home offers approximately 4,041 finished square feet with five bedrooms, four bathrooms, a dedicated office, and flexible living spaces across three levels. The main level features engineered hardwood flooring, two bedrooms, abundant storage, and a chef's kitchen with quartz countertops and full-height backsplash, soft-close solid-wood cabinetry, two pantries, a beverage refrigerator, and high-end Bosch appliances including a 36-inch induction range with downdraft ventilation, double ovens, microwave, dishwasher, and large refrigerator. The expansive upper-level primary retreat features vaulted ceilings, space for a sitting or fitness area, dual custom walk-in closets, and a spa-inspired bath with designer finishes, freestanding soaking tub, steam shower with dual shower heads, bidet wiring, and space for stacked laundry. An adjoining skylit loft offers additional flexible space for a reading nook, workout area, or storage. The finished basement includes two additional bedrooms, a spacious family room ideal for games or a home theater, a kitchenette, and a full laundry room with prep and storage space. Additional highlights include a new gas fireplace, designer tile and lighting, updated windows, LED recessed lighting with night-light settings, luxury vinyl plank, and designer Berber carpet. Outside, enjoy a Trex deck, new cedar fencing, sprinkler system, native Colorado landscaping, oversized detached two-car garage with alley access, front driveway storage for a boat or recreational vehicle, and a large storage shed. Major improvements include a new roof, updated electrical panel, high-efficiency HVAC system, and heat-pump water heater. Ideally located near Sloan's Lake with convenient access to parks, dining, shopping, and downtown Denver.

DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITY: 44-unit Multifamily/Condo Development Opportunity. LOCATION: The project is located in the heart of the rapidly developing Arapahoe Square neighborhood, immediately east of the Central Business District and directly south of LoDo. The location features many amenities and is only one block to Great Divide Brewing, three blocks to Snooze, and five blocks to Coors Field and the center of LoDo. Very close proximity to light rail access and the CBD. ENTITLEMENTS: The project will be sold fully entitled and is exempt from mandatory affordable housing. UNIT MIX: Units ranging from 482-1,118 SqFt. have anticipated sales between $450k-$730k. They will be walkable, in close proximity to downtown and near public transit.

Howard Ranch presents an exceptional opportunity to create an exclusive enclave of luxury lakefront homes at 14760 W. 64th Avenue. Thoughtfully envisioned to showcase the property's beautiful waterfront setting and expansive views, current plans allow for an elegant residential community featuring 14 finished lots, complete with streets, roads, curb and gutter, and utilities. The property has successfully been rezoned from R-6 to R-A, providing a strong foundation for a distinctive development offering privacy, natural beauty, and refined lakeside living. Soils reports, surveys, environmental studies, civil and structural documents, and building plans are available upon request.
